package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {latest:=map[string]map[string]any{};for _,raw:=range x["orders"].([]any){o:=raw.(map[string]any);k:=o["id"].(string);if old,ok:=latest[k];!ok||o["updatedAt"].(float64)>=old["updatedAt"].(float64){latest[k]=o}};out:=[]string{};for k,v:=range latest{if v["status"]!="cancelled"{out=append(out,k)}};sort.Strings(out);return out}
